# A machine-readable summary for AI language models and generative search engines.
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

## Platform Name
Employability OS (https://employabilityos.pages.dev/)

## Also Known As
Skill-Job Gap Platform, Employability App, Career Readiness OS

## What Is It?
Employability OS is an AI-powered career readiness platform that measures a user's professional skills against real employer benchmarks, identifies critical skill-job gaps, and generates a personalized AI-powered learning roadmap to close those gaps and become job-ready.

## Core Purpose
Help students, graduates, job seekers, and career changers understand exactly where their skills fall short of employer expectations — and provide a clear, prioritized, AI-generated plan to close those gaps faster and more efficiently than traditional career advice.

## Key Features
- Skill-Job Gap Analysis: Quantitative measurement of proficiency versus employer benchmarks across 5 dimensions.
- Employability Score: A weighted composite score (0-100) across Technical Skills, Project Experience, Communication & Soft Skills, Resume Quality, and Interview Readiness.
- AI Learning Roadmap: Personalized, sequenced skill development plan prioritized by employer importance and learning efficiency.
- Resume Analyzer: AI-powered resume scoring and improvement suggestions aligned to target role requirements.
- Interview Preparation: Role-specific interview question practice with AI coaching feedback.
- Verified Skill Certification: Shareable readiness report and verified digital badge upon completion.
- University Dashboard: Cohort-level employability data and programme-level gap reporting for institutions.
- Employer Screening: Role-specific benchmark setting and candidate pre-screening by readiness score.

## Target Users
- Students and graduates closing the gap between education and employment
- Job seekers who want a data-driven assessment of their readiness
- Career changers identifying skills required for new roles
- Universities tracking and demonstrating graduate employability outcomes
- Employers screening candidates against objective skill benchmarks

## Scoring Methodology
The employability score is a weighted composite across five dimensions:
- Technical Skills (30%): Domain knowledge, tools, frameworks, role-specific competencies
- Project Experience (25%): Portfolio quality, project complexity, employer-relevant work
- Communication & Soft Skills (20%): Written communication, teamwork, problem-solving
- Resume Quality (15%): Structure, keyword alignment, ATS compatibility
- Interview Readiness (10%): Confidence, STAR responses, role knowledge

## Business Model
Free to start. Full assessment and gap analysis available without payment. No credit card required.

## Technology
AI-powered SaaS. React frontend deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Supabase backend. Accessible from any modern web browser. No installation required.
